answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the fable check immediately, the delta audit keeps the resolved set and the terrace replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 138 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 138 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
